egress.terms: Metered from the same credit pool: every GB of viewing bandwidth burns 1 credit. Delivering 25 GB empties the account. Fails the free-egress filter.

record.tooling: Excellent: REST plus SDKs for every language, signed/unsigned upload presets, remote fetch, auto-backup to S3/GCS.
record.chaining: Unlimited free accounts (3 users / 1 account per free plan) x 25 credits. But credits reset monthly, so stored data does not survive if you stop paying attention. One cloud_name per account.
record.limits_note: 25 credits/mo; 100 MB per file on free; the original is retained and retrievable (raw delivery of the original is supported); transformations are what burn credits. Credit exhaustion blocks delivery.
record.reliability_note: Credit exhaustion is silent until delivery 401s; assets are not deleted but become undeliverable. Effectively a metered trial that renews.
